messages:
Alex: Heads-up — the March invoice has a big unexpected line for asia-east2 GPUs: 'accelerator regional surcharge / rate-change' = $36,842. Not on previous months. Anyone else see this?
Maria: I see the same. Can you paste the exact invoice line?
Alex: pasted snippet from PDF: ```Compute - GPUs | asia-east2 | nvidia-a100-80gb | accelerator: regional-rate-change | Qty: 512 | Unit price: $72.00 | Amount: $36,864.00```
Sam: Oof. That unit price looks wrong compared to our usual $12/hr equivalent. Is that per-hour or per-GB? Need to check raw export.
billing-bot: Automated alert: anomaly detected in billing_export.gcp.line_items for project:redwood-prod — spike in accelerator charges (asia-east2) on 2026-03-05. See /billing/alerts/2026-03-06-42
Kevin: Could this be a change in the cloud provider's SKU mapping? Last time they renamed SKUs we got charged list vs hour mismatch. Check sku_description and start_time in the export.
Maria: Sam, can you run the BQ query to aggregate by sku_id/start_time? Suggestion: ```SELECT sku_id, sku_description, usage_start_time, SUM(usage_amount) AS units, SUM(cost) AS cost FROM `billing_export.gcp.line_items` WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03' AND region = 'asia-east2' GROUP BY sku_id, sku_description, usage_start_time ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 50;```
Sam: Running now. Quick readout: top sku_id = 'A-ACCEL-12345' description 'Accelerator—asia-east2 (on-demand)' — cost jumped on 2026-03-05 when sku_rate changed from 12.00 to 72.00 in the pricing column. I attached query results to thread: https://bq.redwood.internal/queries/9931
Olivia: Is there a Dedicated/Reserved commitment that should've applied? Maybe the export switched matching key so committed-use discount wasn't applied. Check committed_usage_id on those rows.
Alex: Checked a few rows — committed_usage_id is NULL for many of the affected lines. We do have an active commitment for asia-east2 GPUs (commit-asia-2025) that covers ~400 GPUs.
Maria: That suggests mismatch between invoice SKU and commitment SKU. If provider changed SKU token the commitment wouldn't auto-apply. We should open a support case immediately. I'll draft.
Kevin: Also check our capacity provisioning agent — any changes to instance types or labels around 2026-03-05? If we launched new machine types using a different accelerator SKU that could cause both usage and different pricing.
Sam: Quick grep of infra deploys: on 2026-03-04 we deployed a transient pool for training experiments using image tag `train-experiments-a100-80gb-v2`. No config changes to billing labels.
Olivia: OK, next steps: 1) open support case asking for retroactive application of commitment discounts and explanation for the sudden sku_rate change; 2) file internal incident to pause non-critical experiments in asia-east2 until resolved; 3) run a script to remap any instances using the new sku to fall back to standard SKU if possible.
Alex: I'll open the support ticket — copying invoice snippet and BQ export. Draft: "Please investigate sudden sku_rate increase for SKU A-ACCEL-12345 in asia-east2 starting 2026-03-05. Our committed usage ID commit-asia-2025 should cover matching accelerator usage; many affected line_items show committed_usage_id=NULL. Requesting price correction or commitment reapplication"
Maria: Also request tariff history and whether there was a published pricing update. Put the ticket severity high — $36k hit for one month.
Sam: For triage, I also ran aggregation by project label: most of the cost is `project:redwood-training` — I'll DM infra to drain that pool.
billing-bot: Support case created: CASE-8347 with provider. Link: https://support.cloud.vendor/cases/CASE-8347 (status: open).
Kevin: I recommend we enable a guard in our cost pipeline to alert when SKU unit price increases > 20% day-over-day per region. This would have flagged immediately.
Olivia: Agreed. Also add a check that committed_usage_id is present for any accelerator usage when a commitment exists for that region.
Alex: I've assigned action items: Sam — pause training pool (in progress). Maria — own support comms and escalate. Kevin — add alert rule. Olivia — change infra autoscaler to avoid provisioning new asia-east2 allocation until cleared. I'll monitor the support case.
Maria: Thanks. I'll update thread when provider responds. :pray:
